newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia SIR20 rubber steady in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia SIR20 rubber steady in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were steady in slow late trading on Tuesday, dealers said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for December/January shipments were at 55.25-55.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Jambi and Pontianak, at 55.75-56.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 55.00-55.50 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang.
"SIR20 prices are likely to remain steady on Wednesday following Singapore buying this morning," one Medan dealer said.
Another dealer said latex offer prices were also expected to be steady in the coming days due to likely lower supply.
He said some large Medan-based firms were currently loading around 2,000 tonnes of latex for deliveries to the United States following deals done at 95 U.S. cents/kg.
Dealers said Singapore firms bought SIR20 at 55.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Jambi for December deliveries, but the offtakes were in small quantity.
High amoniac grade latex, with 60 percent dry rubber content, was last traded at 2,200 rupiah/kg for October delieveries against the previous 2,230 rupiah, latex dealers said.
